title: BattleReport
description: A detailed analysis and report of a rap battle

clashSummary.description: A 3-5 sentence summary of the battle, highlighting the performance, key moments, and outcome.

performer.description: Name or ID of the MC being analyzed.

overview.description: A high-level overview of their performance.

lyricalThemes.description: The main subjects, metaphors, or angles they used.

title.description: A short title for the highlight (e.g., 'Star Alignment Scheme').

description.description: A brief explanation of how this highlight was executed in their rounds.

performer.description: The MC who delivered the bar.

theme.description: The category or subject of the punchline (e.g., 'Height', 'Family').

bar.description: The exact quote from the transcript.

explanation.description: A brief breakdown of the wordplay or context.

oddMoments.description: List of stumbles, restarts, mic drops, or weird occurrences.

coolMoments.description: List of crowd hype moments, excellent flow switches, or standout punches.

postBattleContext.description: Any additional aftermath context such as crowd votes, host selection, or tournament qualification.
